simple: Access rights management across the whole life of an account (based on Zilla Security): a single record of who has access to what, with change history; automated access review campaigns with AI hints on what to revoke; automatic granting, changing and revoking of rights when a person joins, changes jobs or leaves. Finds orphaned accounts, excessive rights and segregation-of-duties (SoD) conflicts. Connects applications via API, and those without an API (including on-premises ones) via robotic automation (RPA). Prepares reports for SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, DORA and GDPR audits. A cloud service; licensed per user, Standard / Enterprise editions and modules (Comply, Provision, SoD and others).
